cases.task: The source packet explains the product and channels but does not settle the primary action, audience priority, canonical story, or launch date. Build a GTM plan.
expected_behavior: Ask one to three high-value questions before drafting a long plan
Do not invent the missing decisions
Identify which source or person can lock each decision

cases.task: Build a two-week GTM plan from a resolved source packet containing audience, story, launch date, offer, and channel facts.
expected_behavior: Define audience behavior before channel activity
Explain the campaign mechanism before the calendar
Use all 14 calendar days
Label derived workback dates as proposed

cases.task: Connect an editorial calendar to speakers and contributors. Several people have adjacent expertise, but their approved statements do not address the scheduled editorial topics.
expected_behavior: Quote the actual approved statement for every claimed match
Use N/A when there is no credible match
Do not infer expertise or approval

cases.task: Create the social brief for the launch. Include the story, actions and behavior, and ideas to discuss. Keep it under 500 words.
Rewrite from Launch Sequence down. Do not change anything above that heading.
expected_behavior: Fetch the latest document
Preserve the protected prefix exactly
Verify the protected prefix after writing

cases.task: Build a 14-calendar-day plan. Pricing timing is unresolved and should remain an open question. The editorial calendar contains weekend posts.
expected_behavior: Include both weekends
Do not schedule a pricing increase
Keep pricing timing under open questions
Avoid forced editorial connections

cases.task: Revise a GTM one-pager after the document owner has sharpened the positioning and supplied several Slack examples. One example only says that a question uncovered a hidden issue. Another includes the exact request, systems used, shipped result, and correction carried into the next run.
expected_behavior: Treat the owner's edited positioning as canonical
Do not replace it with a smoother paraphrase
Use the example with a verifiable request, action, and result
Retrieve the missing cause before using the vague example
Do not use real as credibility filler
Preserve voice-bearing parentheticals and rough campaign language

cases.task: The product story, audience tension, and hero UVP are still being decided. Pricing facts and launch metrics are available but are not the current assignment.
expected_behavior: Lock the one-line strategy and positioning first
Separate the customer from the first champion
Separate the hero UVP, mechanism, reason to believe, and proof
Record verified pricing facts once without centering them
Do not turn the strategy discussion into a measurement plan
